statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation
The clinical indication is evaluation for suspected paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
Mobile cardiac telemetry, CPT 93229, was ordered
The service was ordered to correlate symptoms with rhythm changes and capture intermittent arrhythmic events
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial concerns missing prior authorization
